zones.note: juniperinstaller.hcahealthcare.com (200) — Juniper VPN client installer endpoint (remote-access entry). Webmail on F5 BigIP (webmail.hcacollab.net → 199.91.40.155, 404 root), owa/hybmail/fw variants, corpad.net mail-firewall + B2B endpoints.

zones.note: Regional hospital brands: HCA Florida, TriStar (TN), St. David's (TX), MountainStar (UT), Sarah Cannon (oncology), CareNow (urgent care), MyMDNow (telehealth). Mostly Azure-fronted; Sarah Cannon + GME on AS14626.
